vibe_rationale: Grew from a psytrance bush doof into a curated, lineup-led three-day electronic festival with a strong scene; single format.
fit_notes: Adult camping crowd on the Murray over three hot days, so hydration and recovery are natural needs. Partners so far are a radio station, a ticketing platform and smaller suppliers, with no health or non-endemic precedent, and the partner policy is unknown. Ask whether non-endemic brands have activated before approaching.
